headline: Europe to Release 42 Million Barrels of Emergency Oil Stocks
summary: European governments will release 42 million barrels of emergency oil stocks over the next three months, including 10 million barrels of diesel from France, to lower fuel prices before winter.
why: Strategic petroleum reserves are released to stabilize energy markets and mitigate price volatility during periods of high demand or supply constraints.

impacts.name: Crude Oil
impacts.why: Increasing supply through reserve releases typically exerts downward pressure on commodity prices.

why_moved: The announcement of a significant supply increase into the market is a classic bearish signal for oil prices.
